Yes, <@529978984902164490> added many new withdrawals tests for that stuff. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4830 So if you're passing the nightly reference tests, that means you're passing these too 🙂 Thanks I'll double check tomorrow they are covered in prysm via code coverage We have some of it implemented in Teku, but mostly not done, adding the commitments would make it easier let me know if there are any test that you think is missing Nice, im on `nightly-21422848633` I see builder sweeping withdrawals, but i dont see any builder pending partial withdrawals There should be builder pending withdrawals. Eg `test_single_builder_withdrawal` Where: Is my nightly tag correct? Sorry on phone now and can't check Yes, it is. That's from 3 days ago: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/21422848633 It should contain all of the new withdrawal tests. Thanks I'll check again. So far I logged the partial withdrawal count and they were 0 <@520034910149410861> This is the minimal change I had in mind to track that bit, I just opened a draft cause I want to have a link for the annotated spec. I think as is it's minimally invasive even with regards to your PR for variable timeliness. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4884 <@&1417820113981145228> we have merged the PR which moves the blob KZG commitments to the bid & started the nightly reference tests action ([`nightly-21532588385`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/21532588385)). Over the weekend, I will try to implement these changes in a client to confirm that the specs are correct. At ACDT on Monday, if it's confirmed that we want to move the commitments to the bid, we will immediately start the release process for `v1.7.0-alpha.2` and it should be ready ~18 hours later.
